hero-eyebrow: vease.app · A video in one minute
hero-title:
You have the footage.
Now make the vlog.
hero-sub: Footage piling up in folders? Let Vease pick shots and shape your story: get a video in one minute. Choose the video length you want, then preview, ask for changes, and approve the export.
hero-note: For Apple Silicon Macs · Private beta
hero-req: Install and start editing. No extra tools or runtime setup needed.
workflow-title: Your footage to a vlog, one approval at a time
workflow-desc: Let AI turn scattered footage into a first cut. Watch how the story flows, check your favorite shots made it in, and adjust as you go.
step1-desc: Put the footage you want to edit into one folder and import it. The app organizes shots while leaving your originals untouched.
step2-desc: Skip opening every video to remember what you filmed. AI describes and tags shots and turns speech into searchable text, so you can find the moments you want.
step3-desc: A quick recap or a story with more detail? Choose your target length, see which shots go where, and adjust the outline before the cut begins.
step4-desc: The same footage can tell different stories. Preview different storylines and choose the pace and approach closest to your vision.
step5-desc: A section dragging on? Leave “Shorten to 10 seconds” on it. Preview the revision and undo it whenever you prefer the previous version.
step6-desc: Listen for music overpowering the conversation and check the pace of the cut. Once you like the preview, export your video and share it.
shots-title: Your footage. Your story. In view.
shot1-alt: Example project footage library with photographic thumbnails, descriptions, scores, and filters
shot1-caption: Stop guessing from filenames. Descriptions and scores sit beside the shots, so you can see what you filmed as you browse. Shown with sample footage.
shot2-alt: Example editing workspace with story outline, shot sequences, section feedback, and a video preview
shot2-caption: Keep the outline, shots, and preview together. Leave feedback on the section that needs work, then see how the revised story flows.
highlights-desc: Several takes of the same shot, a clip that runs too long, and moments you want to keep. Bring your footage together without starting from an empty timeline.
feature1-title: Get past the folder full of footage
feature1-desc: A folder full of filenames you no longer recognize? Let AI organize the shots, suggest an outline, and make a first cut. Press play and start deciding: keep this, shorten that.
feature2-title: Original footage stays on your Mac
feature2-desc: Original footage stays on your Mac. The AI director analyzes selected frames to understand your shots. Preview, adjust, and undo edits as you go.
feature3-title: Start with a folder of footage
feature3-desc: Put your video footage in one folder and import it. Core editing and export tools are built in, so you can start without choosing and learning another editing package.
feature4-title: Ask for the change you want
feature4-desc: “Shorten this section to 10 seconds.” Tell AI what you want without finding the cut points yourself. Preview the result and undo it if you prefer the original.
download-title: Turn your footage into a vlog worth sharing
download-desc: Remember vease.app. Start with a folder of footage and let Vease make the first cut.
